headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto Mutasi 704 Personel Kepolisian
metaDescription: Indonesian National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto has reassigned 704 officers in a major reshuffle affecting regional commanders and detectives.
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto has reassigned 704 police officers in a widespread internal rotation.
The reshuffle involves changes to high-ranking positions, including the appointment of six new regional police chiefs and seven deputy chiefs.
Independently, Kapolda Metro Jaya Komjen Pol Dadang Hartanto has rotated 139 personnel within his jurisdiction, including various investigation unit heads.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian National Police (Polri) has initiated a significant reorganization affecting 704 high-ranking and middle-ranking officers. National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto oversaw the reshuffle, which includes major leadership changes such as the replacement of six regional police chiefs (Kapolda) and seven deputy regional police chiefs (Wakapolda). This structural adjustment is part of a series of strategic internal rotations within the force. Additionally, at the regional level, Kapolda Metro Jaya Komjen Pol Dadang Hartanto has announced the reassignment of 139 personnel under his command. These changes affect several functional roles, including local police precinct heads (Kapolsek) and criminal investigation unit heads (Kasatreskrim). The recent updates to the personnel structure follow broader administrative mandates overseen by the National Police leadership, reflecting ongoing adjustments within the national security apparatus.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to coverage by five independent outlets and a high velocity of reporting following a significant, large-scale reorganization of police leadership.
